definitions.gloss: landing a catch; unloading fish from a boat
definitions.explanation: The act of bringing caught fish or seafood from a fishing boat to the harbor. Also refers to the quantity or value of fish landed.
The total amount of money earned from sales, especially in retail or market contexts.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY: ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧ "water" + {揚|あ}げ "lifting": originally lifting cargo out of the water onto land.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水揚|みずあ}げ⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧: the volume of the catch landed
- {水揚|みずあ}げ{高|だか}: the value of the catch; takings
- 〜⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{水揚|みずあ}げ⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: (fish) is landed
- {水揚|みずあ}げ{港|こう}: a landing port

USAGE: SENSE 2 belongs to businesses paid in daily takings, such as taxis and bars; in ordinary business, {売|う}り{上|あ}げ is the usual word.
